message: In the 48-volt Lithium Iron Phosphate battery bank (LiFePO4, long-life lithium chemistry) (C3), Manager, the night autonomy sizing has missing kilowatt-hour closure problem. To check it I used hand calculation reusing the combined thermal load (E9) capped by staged intake to about 6 kilowatt-hours electric per day (the autonomy sizing calculation (E13)). I found 11.25 kilowatt-hours nominal at 80 percent Depth of Discharge (DoD, usable fraction) for 1.5 days autonomy, according to Azzouz and co-workers, 2020 for Coefficient of Performance (COP, cooling per electricity) 2.5. I propose 48-volt about 240 ampere-hour LiFePO4 bank near 11.5 kilowatt-hours plus ice-bank for night cooling. My position: ready because autonomy energy now closes your objection. In the tilted roof Photovoltaic array (PV, sunlight-to-electricity panels) (C2), Maya, the array undersupply on low-sun days has risk of failing to refill that bank. To check it I used standard off-grid sizing with 5 Peak Sun Hours (PSH, equivalent hours at 1000 watts per square metre) and 25 percent losses (the Photovoltaic array sizing calculation (E14)). I found 1600 watts minimum for 6 kilowatt-hours per day, about 22 kilowatt-hours per day from 5 kilowatts at 5.5 PSH, according to DIY Eco Homes, 2024. I propose 2 kilowatt tilted south roof PV with Maximum Power Point Tracking (MPPT, electronics holding panels at peak power) for cloudy margin. My position: ready because sun-to-load sizing now matches staged duty.
